newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian holiday traffic jams Yugoslav border.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian holiday traffic jams Yugoslav border.

text.p: Christmas traffic and tighter border controls are causing huge delays for cars, trucks and buses waiting to cross from Bulgaria to Yugoslavia, a Bulgarian customs official said on Thursday.
"Vehicles have to wait at least 24 hours to clear customs and cross the border," said Irena Soareva, on duty at the border checkpoint at Bregovo, 170 km (105 miles) north of the capital Sofia.

She said the queue of vehicles was nearly two km (more than a mile) long. Border controls had been strengthened in the last few days and customs officers were checking every car's documents, registration and luggage, she added.
Many of the travellers are Bulgarian traders taking goods to Serbia to sell for Christmas.
